summary: Huntington Bancshares filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 solely to announce a quarterly cash dividend on its Series I Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock (HBANM). No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or management change is reported. The filing is a routine current report of an ordinary dividend declaration and contains no special-situation event.
